title: Threshold-Sharp Conformal Scalar Stability on Carter Slabs and Black Hole Exteriors
summary: We prove a threshold-sharp stability theory for the conformal scalar-curvature sector on zero-curvature Carter backgrounds. The main result is a fully closed bounded-slab theorem: the reflecting evolution is constructed, the conserved energy is proved positive, the complete affine threshold obstruction is identified, and all remaining finite-energy dynamics are shown to be uniformly stable with no unstable modes. This is the sharp statement for compact reflecting slabs, where genuine time decay is false in general. We then extend the same threshold philosophy to black-hole exteriors,…
